Are you sure you want to accept this trade?

• See the trader's Roblox username to join their game
• Chat with the trader to coordinate
• Ping the trader when you're ready to trade

• View the trader's Roblox username & copy it
• Chat with the trader
• Ping the trader when you're ready
• Complete the trade when done
